methodology.observation_window_basis: Prior successful run window_end to current observation cutoff.
methodology.ranking_basis: Materiality, commercialization and deployment, not popularity.
methodology.repeat_policy: Compare immutable event keys; link only material repeats.

provenance.source: Primary sources and immutable GitHub ledger.

findings.headline: GlobalFoundries selected to operate up to $21 billion U.S.-Japan semiconductor fab expansion
findings.summary: GF will operate two planned 300 mm fabs in Malta, New York. The first $10 billion facility targets 2029 and about 900,000 wafers annually; the second is conditional.
findings.why_it_matters: Operator selection and funding materially advance U.S. chip capacity; no new fab is operating yet.
findings.trend_statement: Cross-border fab investment moves toward construction.

source_links.title: GlobalFoundries selected to operate up to $21 billion U.S.-Japan semiconductor fab expansion

findings.headline: AEP plans $4 billion, 702 MW fuel-cell project under 20-year Google power agreement
findings.summary: AEP plans 702 MW of Bloom Energy fuel cells in Wyoming under a 20-year Google PPA, with full operation targeted for 2028.
findings.why_it_matters: Named long-term demand supports new firm AI power; 702 MW remains planned.
findings.trend_statement: AI load growth finances dedicated firm generation.

source_links.title: AEP plans $4 billion, 702 MW fuel-cell project under 20-year Google power agreement

findings.headline: Flex completes EPC Power acquisition to integrate grid-forming conversion for AI data centers
findings.summary: Flex completed its EPC Power acquisition, adding grid-forming power conversion to its AI data-center infrastructure portfolio.
findings.why_it_matters: A completed deal integrates power conversion into an established supplier.
findings.trend_statement: Power, cooling and compute supply chains converge.

source_links.title: Flex completes EPC Power acquisition to integrate grid-forming conversion for AI data centers

findings.headline: Promise Robotics signs multi-year production agreement supporting more than 1,250 D.R. Horton homes
findings.summary: Promise Robotics contracted to support 1,250-plus homes with robotic factory services; its Phoenix factory is planned for 2027.
findings.why_it_matters: A major builder commits production scope; actual home deliveries remain future.
findings.trend_statement: Robotic manufacturing enters construction supply chains.

source_links.title: Promise Robotics signs multi-year production agreement supporting more than 1,250 D.R. Horton homes

findings.headline: IBM and Siemens partner on design and lithography methods for 3D nanostack chips
findings.summary: IBM and Siemens will research EDA, simulation and lithography for experimental 3D nanostack transistors.
findings.why_it_matters: Addresses manufacturability challenges; no commercial production is claimed.
findings.trend_statement: Advanced chip scaling requires design-process co-optimization.

source_links.title: IBM and Siemens partner on design and lithography methods for 3D nanostack chips
